items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ، مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشَّرِّ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا سَأَلَكَ عَبْدُكَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا عَاذَ بِهِ عَبْدُكَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ كُلَّ قَضَاءٍ قَضَيْتَهُ لِي خَيْراً
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka minal-khayri kullihi 'ajilihi wa ajilihi, ma 'alimtu minhu wa ma lam a'lam, wa a'udhu bika minash-sharri kullihi 'ajilihi wa ajilihi ma 'alimtu minhu wa ma lam a'lam. Allahumma inni as'aluka min khayri ma sa'alaka 'abduka, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma 'adha bihi 'abduka. Allahumma inni as'alukal-jannata wa ma qarraba ilayha min qawlin aw 'amal, wa a'udhu bika minan-nari wa ma qarraba ilayha min qawlin aw 'amal, wa as'aluka an taj'ala kulla qada'in qadaytahu li khayra.

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You for all that is good, in this world and in the Hereafter, what I know and what I do not know. I seek refuge in You from all evil, in this world and in the Hereafter, what I know and what I do not know. O Allah, I ask You for the good that Your servant has asked You for, and I seek refuge in You from the evil that Your servant has sought refuge from. O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and whatever words or deeds bring near to it, and I seek refuge in You from the Fire and whatever words or deeds bring near to it. I ask You to make every decree You have decreed for me good.
translation.ar: اللهم إني أسألك من الخير كله عاجله وآجله...

reference.notes: Narrated by Aisha. Classed Sahih by Al-Albani.

virtues.en: The most comprehensive dua ever narrated — encompasses all good in this life and the next.
virtues.ar: أجمع الدعاء الذي ورد عن النبي ﷺ.

items.notes: Featured in A Du'a Away Ep.1 by Dr. Omar Suleiman (Yaqeen Institute).

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اقْسِمْ لَنَا مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ مَا تَحُولُ بِهِ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ مَعَاصِيكَ، وَمِنْ طَاعَتِكَ مَا تُبَلِّغُنَا بِهِ جَنَّتَكَ، وَمِنَ الْيَقِينِ مَا تُهَوِّنُ بِهِ عَلَيْنَا مَصَائِبَ الدُّنْيَا، وَمَتِّعْنَا بِأَسْمَاعِنَا وَأَبْصَارِنَا وَقُوَّتِنَا مَا أَحْيَيْتَنَا، وَاجْعَلْهُ الْوَارِثَ مِنَّا، وَاجْعَلْ ثَأْرَنَا عَلَى مَنْ ظَلَمَنَا، وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى مَنْ عَادَانَا، وَلَا تَجْعَلْ مُصِيبَتَنَا فِي دِينِنَا، وَلَا تَجْعَلِ الدُّنْيَا أَكْبَرَ هَمِّنَا، وَلَا مَبْلَغَ عِلْمِنَا، وَلَا تُسَلِّطْ عَلَيْنَا مَنْ لَا يَرْحَمُنَا
items.transliteration: Allahumma aqsim lana min khashyatika ma tahulu bihi baynana wa bayna ma'asik, wa min ta'atika ma tuballighuna bihi jannataka, wa minal-yaqini ma tuhawwinu bihi 'alayna masa'ibad-dunya, wa matti'na bi-asma'ina wa absarina wa quwwatina ma ahyaytana, waj'alhul-waritha minna, waj'al tha'arana 'ala man zalamana, wansurna 'ala man 'adana, wa la taj'al musibatana fi dinina, wa la taj'alid-dunya akbara hammina, wa la mablagha 'ilmina, wa la tusallit 'alayna man la yarhamuna.

translation.en: O Allah, apportion to us such fear of You as will come between us and acts of disobedience to You, and such obedience to You as will bring us to Your Garden, and such certainty as will make it easy for us to bear the calamities of this world. Let us enjoy our hearing, sight, and strength as long as You grant us life, and let it be the inheritor from us. Let our vengeance be upon those who wronged us, and aid us against those who show enmity to us. Let no calamity befall our religion, let not the world be our greatest concern, the limit of our knowledge, and do not give power over us to those who do not show us mercy.
translation.ar: اللهم اقسم لنا من خشيتك ما يحول به بيننا وبين معاصيك...

reference.notes: Narrated by Abdullah bin Umar.

virtues.en: Contentment is a du'a away — this dua asks for the balance between fear and hope that brings inner peace.
virtues.ar: القناعة دعوة بعيداً.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ، وَاقْدُرْ لِي الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi'ilmika, wa astaqdiruka biqudratika, wa as'aluka min fadlikal-'azim, fa innaka taqdiru wa la aqdiru, wa ta'lamu wa la a'lamu, wa anta 'allamul-ghuyub. Allahumma in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra khayrun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa 'aqibati amri faqdurhu li wa yassirhu li thumma barik li fihi, wa in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra sharrun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa 'aqibati amri fasrifhu 'anni wasrifni 'anhu, wa qdur lial-khayra haythu kana thumma ardini bihi.

translation.en: O Allah, I seek Your guidance (in making a choice) by virtue of Your knowledge, and I seek ability by virtue of Your power, and I ask You of Your great bounty. You have power, I have none. You know, I know not. You are the Knower of hidden things. O Allah, if in Your knowledge, this matter is good for my religion, my livelihood, and the outcome of my affairs, then ordain it for me, make it easy for me, and bless it for me. If in Your knowledge it is bad for my religion, my livelihood, and the outcome of my affairs, then turn it away from me, and turn me away from it. Ordain for me the good wherever it is, and make me content with it.
translation.ar: اللهم إني أستخيرك بعلمك...

virtues.en: Your decision is a du'a away — the Prophet ﷺ taught this to his Companions as he taught them a surah from the Quran.
virtues.ar: قرارك دعوة بعيداً.
